properties.notes: Town centre public house and adjoining land that is now vacant following closure. Now identified for redevelopment, offering a chance to provide new housing in the centre of Alnwick. Project likely to be through combination of a conversion of the existing building and potentially some additional new-build. Permission now secured for a scheme of 6 units (18/01400/FUL). This comprises of alteration and conversion of the vacant pub to 4 flats, along with a further 2 new-build cottages to the rear. Development yet to commence but forecast for completion within the next 5 years.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
